const S={left:null,right:null,matched:new Set(),lock:false,voice:null,size:8,pool:[],category:CATEGORIES.food};
const $=q=>document.querySelector(q);
function show(id){["home","categories","food-subcategories","number-subcategories","size","game"].forEach(x=>$("#"+x).classList.toggle("hidden",x!==id))}
function shuffle(a){a=[...a];for(let i=a.length-1;i;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a}
function speak(t){if(!("speechSynthesis" in window))return;speechSynthesis.cancel();const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(t);u.lang="en-US";u.rate=.82;u.pitch=1.05;if(S.voice){u.voice=S.voice;u.lang=S.voice.lang}speechSynthesis.speak(u)}
function tone(ok){const A=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!A)return;const c=new A(),fs=ok?[523,659,784]:[220,185];let t=c.currentTime;fs.forEach(f=>{const o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=f;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.2,t+.02);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+.22);o.connect(g).connect(c.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+.24);t+=.11})}
function burst(){const b=$("#confetti"),colors=["#ff6b4a","#ffc93c","#1fb8a6","#7c5cfc","#3dd68c"];b.innerHTML="";for(let i=0;i<18;i++){const p=document.createElement("i");p.className="piece";p.style.left=Math.random()*100+"%";p.style.background=colors[i%5];p.style.animationDelay=Math.random()*.15+"s";b.appendChild(p)}setTimeout(()=>b.innerHTML="",1300)}
function reset(newSet=false){if(newSet||!S.pool.length)S.pool=shuffle(S.category.items).slice(0,S.size);S.left=S.right=null;S.matched=new Set;S.lock=false;$("#count").textContent=0;$("#total").textContent=S.pool.length;$("#finish").classList.add("hidden");render()}
function layout(n){return n===8?{cols:4,rows:4,mcols:4,mrows:4,width:"720px",height:"560px"}:n===14?{cols:7,rows:4,mcols:4,mrows:7,width:"920px",height:"600px"}:{cols:8,rows:5,mcols:5,mrows:8,width:"1050px",height:"650px"}}
function render(){const B=$("#board"),conf=$("#confetti");B.querySelectorAll(".tile").forEach(e=>e.remove());const g=layout(S.pool.length);B.style.setProperty("--cols",g.cols);B.style.setProperty("--rows",g.rows);B.style.setProperty("--mobile-cols",g.mcols);B.style.setProperty("--mobile-rows",g.mrows);B.style.setProperty("--board-width",g.width);B.style.setProperty("--board-height",g.height);
const cards=shuffle(S.pool.flatMap(x=>[{side:"left",x},{side:"right",x}]));
cards.forEach(({side,x})=>{const b=document.createElement("button");b.className=`tile ${side==="left"?"image-tile":"word-tile"}`;b.dataset.id=x.id;b.dataset.side=side;if(side==="left"){if(x.art)b.innerHTML=artSvg(x.art);else if(x.image)b.innerHTML=``;else if(x.pic)b.textContent=x.pic;else if(x.number!==undefined)b.innerHTML=`${x.number}`;else b.innerHTML=``}else b.innerHTML=`🔊${x.en}${x.phon}`;b.onclick=()=>pick(side,x,b);B.appendChild(b)});B.appendChild(conf)}
function clear(){document.querySelectorAll(".selected,.wrong").forEach(e=>e.classList.remove("selected","wrong"));S.left=S.right=null}
function pick(side,x,b){if(S.lock||S.matched.has(x.id))return;speak(x.en);const k=side==="left"?"left":"right";if(S[k]===x.id){S[k]=null;b.classList.remove("selected");return}
document.querySelectorAll(`.tile[data-side="${side}"].selected`).forEach(e=>e.classList.remove("selected"));S[k]=x.id;b.classList.add("selected");if(S.left&&S.right)check()}
function check(){S.lock=true;if(S.left===S.right){const id=S.left;tone(true);burst();setTimeout(()=>{S.matched.add(id);document.querySelectorAll(`.tile[data-id="${id}"]`).forEach(e=>{e.classList.remove("selected");e.classList.add("matched");e.disabled=true});S.left=S.right=null;S.lock=false;$("#count").textContent=S.matched.size;if(S.matched.size===S.pool.length)setTimeout(()=>$("#finish").classList.remove("hidden"),500)},260)}
else{tone(false);document.querySelectorAll(".selected").forEach(e=>e.classList.add("wrong"));setTimeout(()=>{clear();S.lock=false},650)}}
function voices(){if(!("speechSynthesis" in window))return;const vs=speechSynthesis.getVoices(),us=vs.filter(v=>v.lang&&v.lang.toLowerCase()==="en-us"),female=["google us english","jenny","aria","zira","samantha","female"];S.voice=female.map(h=>us.find(v=>v.name.toLowerCase().includes(h))).find(Boolean)||us.find(v=>!["david","mark","guy","george","male"].some(h=>v.name.toLowerCase().includes(h)))||us[0]||vs.find(v=>v.lang&&v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith("en"))||null}
function sizeOptions(){const box=$("#sizes"),max=S.category.items.length,counts=[...new Set([8,14,Math.min(20,max)])].filter(n=>n<=max);$("#size-subtitle").textContent=`${S.category.emoji} ${S.category.name} — wybierz długość gry`;box.innerHTML="";counts.forEach((n,i)=>{const b=document.createElement("button");b.className="size-card";b.dataset.count=n;b.innerHTML=`${n}${i===0?"krótka":i===counts.length-1?"pełna":"średnia"}`;b.onclick=()=>{S.size=n;reset(true);show("game")};box.appendChild(b)})}
function openSize(category,backTarget){S.category=category;S.pool=[];$("#size-back").dataset.target=backTarget;sizeOptions();show("size")}
$("#play").onclick=()=>show("categories");document.querySelectorAll(".category").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const key=b.dataset.category;if(key==="food")show("food-subcategories");else if(key==="numbers")show("number-subcategories");else openSize(CATEGORIES[key],"categories")});document.querySelectorAll(".food-subcategory").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openSize(FOOD_SUBCATEGORIES[b.dataset.food],"food-subcategories"));document.querySelectorAll(".number-subcategory").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openSize(NUMBER_SUBCATEGORIES[b.dataset.numbers],"number-subcategories"));document.querySelectorAll(".back").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>show(b.dataset.target));$("#replay").onclick=()=>reset(true);$("#topics").onclick=()=>{$("#finish").classList.add("hidden");show("categories")};
voices();if("speechSynthesis" in window)speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged=voices;
